claim: ADR 0235 (migrations numbered at merge, cited by slug) rests on two guards staying in CI: ci.yml runs scripts/check_migration_versions_unique.py and scripts/check_migration_order.py, each with --self-test, in the migration-versions-unique job, and CI Complete needs that job
verify: test -f .planning/decisions/0235-a-migration-is-numbered-at-merge-and-cited-by-its-slug.md && f=.github/workflows/ci.yml; grep -q '\./scripts/check_migration_versions_unique.py --self-test' $f && grep -q '\./scripts/check_migration_order.py --self-test' $f && grep -q '\./scripts/check_migration_order.py --event' $f && grep -qE '^ +run: \./scripts/check_migration_versions_unique.py$' $f && awk '/^ +needs: *\[/{n=1} n&&/^ +migration-versions-unique,/{ok=1} /^ +\]/{n=0} END{exit !ok}' $f
